decisions.statement: A landing with no change commits nothing and answers no sha.
A body to write goes in through the change adding a file.
A path to take away goes through the change removing a file.
One landing has both the bodies written and the removals.
A path is named against the root the landing is made in rather than absolutely.
The sha is the one the landing answers rather than one read out of a report.
A landing that stopped after it committed is refused naming that commit.
The bodies go into the landing in process rather than out to the pages service or a command line.
The writer an act names is read by nothing.

definition: bodies written and paths taken away in one mechanical landing, answering the sha it made
